offering_description.value: Fortive sells electrical test instruments, gas detectors and operations software to industrial companies, facility operators and public agencies. It sells sterilization equipment and supplies, clinical workflow software and radiation monitoring services to healthcare providers. It manufactures instruments and equipment and delivers software and services through cloud platforms and specialist teams.

primary_products.value: Electrical test and measurement instruments; industrial gas detectors; facilities, maintenance and safety software; medical sterilization equipment and consumables; clinical workflow software

primary_services.value: Instrument calibration and repair; construction procurement and cost estimating; managed gas detection; radiation dose monitoring

customer_segment.value: B2B: Industrial plants, utilities, facility operators, contractors, hospitals and outpatient clinics; B2G: Public works departments, school districts and government healthcare facilities; B2C: Individuals buying handheld electrical test tools

end_markets.value: Industrial manufacturing; utilities and energy; commercial facilities management; public infrastructure and construction; healthcare

revenue_model.value: product sales: Test instruments, gas detectors, sterilization equipment and recurring consumables; subscription: Facilities, maintenance, safety and clinical workflow software; service fees: Calibration, repairs and radiation dose monitoring; project or contract: Construction procurement support and managed gas detection programs
revenue_model.category: product sales; subscription; service fees; project or contract

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: Uses electronic components and sensors to make test, detection and sterilization equipment for industrial and healthcare customers; software / platform: Uses asset, safety and clinical data to provide workflow tools for facilities teams and healthcare providers; service provider: Uses construction cost data, calibration equipment and dosimetry systems to serve public agencies, industrial operators and healthcare providers
value_chain_position.category: OEM / manufacturer; software / platform; service provider

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific and other international markets

specialization.value: diversified: Industrial testing and safety, facilities and construction software, healthcare sterilization, clinical workflows and radiation monitoring

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Sales teams serving industrial accounts, facility operators, public agencies and healthcare providers; distributors / dealers: Electrical test, industrial safety and medical equipment distributors; online: Company and authorized distributor websites selling test instruments and accessories; third-party retail: Hardware and home-improvement retailers carrying handheld test tools
distribution_channels.category: direct sales; distributors / dealers; online; third-party retail
